title: 工业激光切割：过程、部件与打标
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/01_Innovative Laser Cutting Industrial Jan2020SloMo MusicCam Vizion wwwPhoto.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/01_Innovative Laser Cutting Industrial Jan2020SloMo MusicCam Vizion wwwPhoto/src.py

points.K3: 切割头、压力表和格栅台

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台工业激光切割机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large industrial laser cutting machine and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天带大家看看工业激光切割。
overlay: 看懂激光切割，也看懂它的危险

shots.scene: 金属零件、切割头、火花、打标四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a metal part, a laser cutting head, flying sparks and an engraved part. No people.
shots.narration: 看它怎么切零件，怎么打标。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研站在桌边，看着图纸上几叠金属零件
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student stand at a bench looking at stacks of metal parts on blank drawings.
shots.narration: 阿杰和小研收到一批金属零件。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一块连接板，满脸好奇
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a metal strip with holes and looks at it curiously.
shots.narration: 边缘这么整齐，是怎么切出来的？

shots.scene: 老李招手，带两人走向车间里的激光切割机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer waves and leads the two students toward a laser cutting machine in a workshop.
shots.narration: 老李带他们去看激光切割机。

shots.scene: 图纸上摆着几叠切好的垫片、连接板和方框件
shots.prompt_en: Several neat stacks of laser-cut metal parts on blank engineering drawings: round washers, long plates with holes and square frame pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 激光切割能按图纸切出各种金属件。

shots.scene: 垫片、长条连接板、方框厚件三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a round washer, a long plate with holes and a thick square frame piece. No people.
shots.narration: 垫片、连接板、支架，还有厚板件。

shots.scene: 一叠形状完全相同的长条连接板
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a tall stack of identical metal strips with matching holes and chamfered ends. No people.
shots.narration: 成批切出，大小孔位都一样。

shots.scene: 小研拿起一个垫片，与旁边的图纸比对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a metal washer and compares it with a blank drawing on the bench.
shots.narration: 按需定制，图纸画什么就切什么。

shots.scene: 示意图：一束光从切割头向下聚成一点，落在钢板上
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a light beam inside a cutting head narrows down to a bright focal point on a steel sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 激光聚焦在切割头下方的板材上。

shots.scene: 钢板上的亮点处金属熔化，气流向下吹出熔渣
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram: metal melts at the bright spot and a downward gas stream blows molten droplets through the cut. No people.
shots.narration: 金属熔化，被气流从切口吹走。

shots.scene: 慢动作：切割头下火花向四周飞溅
shots.prompt_en: Slow motion: orange sparks spray outward from under a laser cutting head on a steel sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 慢动作里，切口处火花四溅。

shots.scene: 切割头在钢板上切出一个圆孔，火花呈弧线飞散
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a cutting head cuts a round hole in a steel sheet, orange sparks flying in arcs. No people.
shots.narration: 切直线、切圆孔，火花跟着走。

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表和格栅台
shots.scene: 切割头特写：机头上有一块圆形压力表
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a cutting head with a round analog pressure gauge with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 切割头旁有辅助气体压力表。
overlay: 切割头、压力表和格栅台

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表和格栅台
shots.scene: 老李指着压力表给阿杰看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at the pressure gauge on the cutting head while the young male student looks.
shots.narration: 吹走熔渣的气流，压力看这块表。

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表和格栅台
shots.scene: 钢板平放在一排排带长条孔的格栅台面上
shots.prompt_en: A steel sheet lies flat on a slatted grid table with rows of long slots. No people.
shots.narration: 板材放在格栅式工作台上。

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表和格栅台
shots.scene: 剖面图：熔渣从切口落进台面下方的通道
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram: molten slag drops through the cut into a channel under the grid table. No people.
shots.narration: 台面下方留出通道，排出熔渣。

shots.scene: L形金属支架表面刻着空白图标和一串点线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an L-shaped steel bracket with a laser-engraved blank logo shape and a dotted line pattern, no readable text. No people.
shots.narration: 激光还能在零件表面打标。

shots.scene: 圆形垫片上刻着标志和编号的形状
shots.prompt_en: A round metal washer with an engraved blank logo shape and a row of small engraved marks, no readable text. No people.
shots.narration: 刻上标志、文字和编号。

shots.scene: 装上拨动开关的L形支架，一个零件连到空白记录册
shots.prompt_en: An L-shaped bracket fitted with a toggle switch, and an arrow from the engraved part to a blank record book. No people.
shots.narration: 装到产品上，一看就能识别追溯。

shots.scene: 老李把切好的零件按批码放，逐件对照图纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stacks finished parts in batches and checks each against a blank drawing.
shots.narration: 切好的零件按批次堆放。

shots.scene: 小研把零件放到图纸上比对，打勾后装箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lays a part on a blank drawing, gives a check mark, then packs the parts into a box.
shots.narration: 与图纸核对无误后交付。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现零件、切割头、格栅台、打标四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four icons: metal parts, a cutting head, a grid table and an engraved part.
shots.narration: 按图成批切零件，激光熔化气流吹渣。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研看着整齐的零件点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student nod while looking at neat stacks of finished parts.
shots.narration: 看压力表，格栅排渣，打标追溯。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研、老李在切割机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student, the female graduate student and the facility engineer beside the laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 激光切割就看到这里，下次见！
